# Research: sports-data-apis

*Auto-generated by AIDLC planning session*

**Question:** What free or low-cost APIs provide reliable real-time scores, game timelines, and play-by-play data for major US sports (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL)? What are the rate limits, data freshness guarantees, and licensing restrictions for public/freemium tiers?

---

# Free & Low-Cost Sports Data APIs: Real-Time Scores, Timelines & Play-by-Play

**Sports covered:** NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL
**Focus:** Free/freemium tiers — rate limits, data freshness, licensing

---

## 1. ESPN Hidden/Undocumented Public API

**Base URL:** `https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/`
**Status:** Unofficial — no public docs, no auth required, no SLA

### Overview
ESPN exposes a large set of JSON endpoints used by their own web/mobile clients. These are publicly accessible without API keys. ESPN has not formally shut down third-party usage, but there is no guarantee of uptime or schema stability.

### Key Endpoints

| Sport | Scoreboard | Play-by-Play |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| NFL | `/football/nfl/scoreboard` | `/football/nfl/summary?event={gameId}` |
| NBA | `/basketball/nba/scoreboard` | `/basketball/nba/summary?event={gameId}` |
| MLB | `/baseball/mlb/scoreboard` | `/baseball/mlb/summary?event={gameId}` |
| NHL | `/hockey/nhl/scoreboard` | `/hockey/nhl/summary?event={gameId}` |

### Data Freshness
- Scoreboards: ~30–60 second polling lag during live games
- Play-by-play in `summary`: updated roughly every play, but latency is inconsistent (30s–3min observed)
- No websocket; must poll

### Rate Limits
- No enforced rate limit published, but aggressive polling (>1 req/sec sustained) risks IP blocks
- Community-observed safe zone: ~1 req/10s per endpoint

### Licensing
- **No license granted.** ESPN Terms of Service prohibit scraping and commercial redistribution. Suitable for personal projects, research, or development/prototyping only.

### Code Example (Node.js)
```javascript
const res = await fetch(
  'https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/scoreboard'
);
const data = await res.json();
for (const event of data.events) {
  const comp = event.competitions[0];
  const home = comp.competitors.find(c => c.homeAway === 'home');
  const away = comp.competitors.find(c => c.homeAway === 'away');
  console.log(`${away.team.abbreviation} ${away.score} @ ${home.team.abbreviation} ${home.score} — ${comp.status.type.shortDetail}`);
}
```

### Play-by-Play Example
```javascript
const gameId = '401585476'; // from scoreboard event.id
const res = await fetch(
  `https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/summary?event=${gameId}`
);
const data = await res.json();
const plays = data.plays ?? [];
plays.slice(-10).forEach(p => console.log(`Q${p.period.number} ${p.clock.displayValue} — ${p.text}`));
```

## 2. The Sports DB (TheSportsDB)

**URL:** `https://www.thesportsdb.com/api.php`
**Pricing:** Free (v1, limited) | Patreon $5/mo (v2, full)

### Overview
Community-maintained sports database. Strong on historical data, team/player metadata, and league schedules. Live scores are available on v2 (paid) only.

### Free Tier (v1 — API key: `1`)
- Team lookups, player lookups, event results (past games)
- League standings (not always real-time)
- **No live scores or play-by-play on free tier**
- Rate limit: ~30 req/min

### Paid Tier (v2 — $5/mo Patreon)
- Live scores endpoint: `https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v2/json/{key}/livescore.php?l=4387` (NBA)
- Refreshed every ~60 seconds via their aggregation
- Still no play-by-play

### Sports / League IDs
| League | ID |
|--------|----|
| NFL | 4391 |
| NBA | 4387 |
| MLB | 4424 |
| NHL | 4380 |

### Licensing
- Free for non-commercial, attribution required
- Commercial use requires separate arrangement

### Code Example (Free Tier — Recent Results)
```python
import requests

league_id = 4387  # NBA
url = f"https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v1/json/1/eventspastleague.php?id={league_id}"
r = requests.get(url)
events = r.json().get("events", [])
for e in events[:5]:
    print(f"{e['strEvent']} — {e['intHomeScore']}:{e['intAwayScore']} on {e['dateEvent']}")
```

## 3. MySportsFeeds

**URL:** `https://www.mysportsfeeds.com`
**Pricing:** Free (non-commercial dev) | $9–$49/mo (commercial tiers)

### Overview
One of the most developer-friendly freemium APIs. Well-documented REST API with consistent schemas across all four major US sports.

### Free (Non-Commercial) Tier
- Access to **current season data only** (not historical beyond current season)
- Scores, standings, schedules, rosters
- **Play-by-play:** available at $9+/mo tier
- Rate limit: 250 req/hour on free; 2,500/hour at $9/mo
- Response format: JSON or XML

### Data Freshness
- Live game feeds updated every ~30–90 seconds (depends on tier)
- "Near-real-time" described as a feature at paid tiers; free tier may lag 3–5 min

### Key Endpoints (v2.1)
```
GET /2.1/pull/{sport}/{season}/games.json
GET /2.1/pull/{sport}/{season}/game_playbyplay.json?game={gameId}
GET /2.1/pull/{sport}/{season}/scoreboard.json
```
Sports slugs: `nfl`, `nba`, `mlb`, `nhl`

### Authentication
HTTP Basic Auth — username:password as registered credentials.

### Licensing
- Free tier: non-commercial, personal, and educational use
- Commercial redistribution requires paid tier + terms agreement

### Code Example (Python)
```python
import requests
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth

auth = HTTPBasicAuth('your_username', 'your_password')
url = "https://api.mysportsfeeds.com/v2.1/pull/nba/2024-2025-regular/scoreboard.json"
params = {"date": "20250115"}
r = requests.get(url, auth=auth, params=params)
games = r.json().get("games", [])
for g in games:
    s = g["score"]
    print(f"{g['schedule']['awayTeam']['abbreviation']} {s['awayScoreTotal']} @ {g['schedule']['homeTeam']['abbreviation']} {s['homeScoreTotal']}")
```

## 4. Sportradar (Free Trial / Sandbox)

**URL:** `https://developer.sportradar.com`
**Pricing:** Free sandbox (simulated/trial data) | $0–$150/mo live tiers

### Overview
Sportradar is the industry-standard provider used by ESPN, major sportsbooks, and media companies. Their free "trial" tier gives access to sandboxed (simulated, not live) data but with full schema fidelity — useful for development.

### Free Sandbox Tier
- Simulated push feeds and REST endpoints for all four sports
- Full play-by-play, drive charts (NFL), pitch-by-pitch (MLB)
- 1,000 req/month on trial
- Data is NOT live — it replays historical games as if live

### Live Data Tiers
- **Bronze (~$0–$9/mo):** delayed data (10–15 min), ~5,000 req/month
- **Silver ($49–$99/mo):** near-real-time (< 60s), higher limits
- Push streaming (websocket) available at Silver+

### API Products Relevant to This Use Case
| Product | Notes |
|---------|-------|
| NFL Official Data Feed | Push + REST, drive summaries, play-by-play |
| NBA Live Data | Possession-level events |
| MLB Official Data | Pitch-by-pitch, Statcast-adjacent |
| NHL Official Data | Shot attempts, faceoffs, real-time events |

### Data Freshness (Live Tiers)
- REST polling: 30–60s typical
- Push/streaming: sub-5s for in-play events at Silver+

### Licensing
- Trial: development/testing only, no public display
- Live tiers: display rights vary by sport and region — NFL/NBA data has strict redistribution terms; must review per-sport addendum

### Code Example (REST — NBA Scoreboard Sandbox)
```javascript
const API_KEY = 'your_trial_key';
const res = await fetch(
  `https://api.sportradar.com/nba/trial/v8/en/games/2025/01/15/schedule.json?api_key=${API_KEY}`
);
const schedule = await res.json();
schedule.games.forEach(g => {
  console.log(`${g.away.alias} @ ${g.home.alias} — Status: ${g.status}`);
});
```

## 5. API-Sports (api-sports.io)

**URL:** `https://api-sports.io` / `https://v1.basketball.api-sports.io`
**Pricing:** Free (100 req/day) | $9.99–$49.99/mo

### Overview
RapidAPI-hosted provider with separate APIs per sport. Clean REST JSON, good documentation, and relatively generous free tier for development.

### Free Tier
- **100 requests/day** (resets midnight UTC)
- All endpoints accessible including live scores
- No play-by-play — only game-level scores, quarters/periods, halftime

### Paid Tiers
| Plan | Req/day | Price |
|------|---------|-------|
| Starter | 7,500 | $9.99/mo |
| Pro | 75,000 | $29.99/mo |
| Business | unlimited | $49.99/mo |

### Data Freshness
- Live games endpoint updated every ~60 seconds
- "Live" flag on game objects indicates in-progress status

### Sports APIs and Hosts
| Sport | Base URL |
|-------|----------|
| NBA | `https://v2.nba.api-sports.io` |
| NFL | `https://v1.american-football.api-sports.io` |
| MLB | `https://v1.baseball.api-sports.io` |
| NHL | `https://v1.hockey.api-sports.io` |

### Authentication
Header: `x-apisports-key: YOUR_KEY`

### Code Example (NBA Live Scores)
```python
import requests

headers = {"x-apisports-key": "YOUR_API_KEY"}
url = "https://v2.nba.api-sports.io/games"
params = {"live": "all"}
r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
for game in r.json().get("response", []):
    scores = game["scores"]
    teams = game["teams"]
    print(
        f"{teams['visitors']['name']} {scores['visitors']['points']} "
        f"@ {teams['home']['name']} {scores['home']['points']} "
        f"— Q{game['periods']['current']}"
    )
```

## 6. Official League APIs (Free, Unofficial)

### NHL Stats API
**Base URL:** `https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/`
**Status:** Official NHL infrastructure, public, no auth required

The NHL runs a public-facing API that powers their own apps. This is the most reliable free option for NHL.

```
GET /score/now                    # Live scoreboard
GET /gamecenter/{gameId}/play-by-play
GET /gamecenter/{gameId}/landing   # Game summary
```

**Data freshness:** ~10–30s during live games
**Rate limits:** Not published; community reports ~2 req/sec before throttling
**Licensing:** No explicit terms; commercial use legally murky

```javascript
// NHL live scores
const res = await fetch('https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/score/now');
const data = await res.json();
data.games.forEach(g => {
  console.log(`${g.awayTeam.abbrev} ${g.awayTeam.score ?? 0} @ ${g.homeTeam.abbrev} ${g.homeTeam.score ?? 0} — ${g.gameState}`);
});

// NHL play-by-play
const pbp = await fetch('https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/gamecenter/2024020512/play-by-play');
const pbpData = await pbp.json();
pbpData.plays.slice(-5).forEach(p => console.log(`${p.periodDescriptor.number}P ${p.timeInPeriod} — ${p.typeDescKey}: ${p.details?.descKey ?? ''}`));
```

### MLB Stats API
**Base URL:** `https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/`
**Status:** Official MLB, public, no auth

```
GET /schedule?sportId=1&date=2025-04-15&hydrate=linescore
GET /game/{gamePk}/playByPlay
GET /game/{gamePk}/linescore
```

**Data freshness:** ~30s for scores, ~15–30s for play-by-play (pitch data)
**Rate limits:** ~5 req/sec observed limit; IP block after sustained abuse
**Licensing:** MLB has asserted IP over its game data in court historically; commercial use requires a license

```python
import requests

# Live scoreboard
schedule = requests.get(
    "https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule",
    params={"sportId": 1, "hydrate": "linescore,teams"}
).json()

for date in schedule.get("dates", []):
    for game in date.get("games", []):
        ls = game.get("linescore", {})
        print(
            f"{game['teams']['away']['team']['name']} {ls.get('teams', {}).get('away', {}).get('runs', '-')} "
            f"@ {game['teams']['home']['team']['name']} {ls.get('teams', {}).get('home', {}).get('runs', '-')} "
            f"— Inn {ls.get('currentInningOrdinal', '?')}"
        )

# Play-by-play
pbp = requests.get("https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/game/745528/playByPlay").json()
for play in pbp.get("allPlays", [])[-3:]:
    result = play["result"]
    about = play["about"]
    print(f"Inn {about['inning']} {'Top' if about['isTopInning'] else 'Bot'} — {result['description']}")
```

### NFL / NBA
The NFL and NBA do **not** expose official public APIs for real-time data. All live NFL/NBA data flows through licensed partners (Sportradar, Stats Perform, etc.).

## 7. SportsDataIO (formerly fantasydata.com)

**URL:** `https://sportsdata.io`
**Pricing:** Free trial (key required) | $29–$299/mo

### Overview
Developer-focused API with excellent documentation and per-sport SDKs (C#, Java, Python, Node). Commonly used in fantasy sports applications.

### Free Trial
- 7-day full-access trial, no credit card required
- Access to all endpoints: box scores, play-by-play, props, injuries
- After trial: some "always-free" endpoints remain (season schedule, team info)

### Data Freshness
- Live box scores: ~30s polling
- Play-by-play: ~45s, available during/post-game
- No push/websocket on entry tiers

### Notable Endpoints
```
GET /v3/nfl/scores/json/ScoresByDate/{date}
GET /v3/nfl/stats/json/PlayByPlay/{gameKey}
GET /v3/nba/scores/json/GamesByDate/{date}
GET /v3/mlb/scores/json/GamesByDate/{date}
GET /v3/nhl/scores/json/GamesByDate/{date}
```

### Licensing
- Trial and paid tiers require a subscription agreement
- Redistribution of raw data prohibited at all tiers
- Display rights included for subscriber's own app

## Practical Recommendations by Use Case

### Personal project / hobby app
**Best options:** ESPN unofficial + NHL/MLB official APIs
- No cost, no keys required
- Sufficient freshness for casual display
- Understand you're operating outside ToS for ESPN

### Development / prototyping (building toward commercial)
**Best options:** Sportradar sandbox (for schema design) + MySportsFeeds free tier
- Sportradar sandbox gives you the richest schema to design against
- MySportsFeeds free gives you real data to validate against during dev

### Commercial app (display to end users)
**Best options:** MySportsFeeds $9/mo or API-Sports Starter $9.99/mo
- Legitimate license, consistent uptime SLAs
- For play-by-play, MySportsFeeds $9+ or SportsDataIO paid tiers
- For serious scale or official data rights: Sportradar Silver+ ($49/mo+)

### Fantasy sports / sports betting context
- **Sportradar** or **Stats Perform** (not listed here — enterprise only) are the production-grade choices
- Both require formal agreements with display and redistribution addenda
- Expect $200–$2,000/mo at commercial scale

---

## Key Caveats on Data Rights

1. **NFL data is highly protected.** The NFL has exclusive data licensing deals. Any real-time NFL play-by-play from a third party technically flows through a licensed aggregator. ESPN's unofficial API data for NFL is derived from their licensed feeds — redistribution compounds the IP issue.

2. **NBA similarly protective.** Sportradar holds the official NBA data rights globally. All other providers license from or proxy Sportradar.

3. **MLB is litigious.** MLB has historically pursued legal action over unauthorized use of game data (see *C.B.C. Distribution v. MLB* and related cases). The public statsapi.mlb.com is tolerated but not formally licensed.

4. **NHL is most permissive.** Their public API appears intentionally exposed and they have not pursued enforcement actions against developers using it reasonably.

5. **Display rights vs. data rights** are separate. Even if a provider licenses you the *data*, displaying it publicly (especially for commercial purposes involving scores/odds) may require additional display rights from the leagues.

## Polling Strategy for Near-Real-Time Feel

Since no free API offers websocket push, a practical polling architecture:

```javascript
class SportsPollManager {
  constructor(endpoints, intervalMs = 30000) {
    this.endpoints = endpoints;
    this.interval = intervalMs;
    this.timers = new Map();
  }

  start(key, url, onUpdate) {
    const poll = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(url);
        const data = await res.json();
        onUpdate(data);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`Poll failed for ${key}:`, e.message);
      }
    };
    poll(); // immediate first fetch
    this.timers.set(key, setInterval(poll, this.interval));
  }

  stop(key) {
    clearInterval(this.timers.get(key));
    this.timers.delete(key);
  }

  // Adaptive: slow down when no live games
  setInterval(key, ms) {
    this.stop(key);
    // caller responsible for restarting with new interval
  }
}

// Usage: poll NHL every 20s during live window, 5min otherwise
const mgr = new SportsPollManager();
mgr.start('nhl-scores', 'https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/score/now', data => {
  const liveGames = data.games.filter(g => g.gameState === 'LIVE');
  console.log(`${liveGames.length} live NHL games`);
});
```

## Summary of Best Free Stack (No Cost)

For a project needing all four sports with no budget:

| Sport | Recommended Free Source | Play-by-Play |
|-------|------------------------|-------------|
| NHL | `api-web.nhle.com/v1` (official) | Yes — full event log |
| MLB | `statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1` (official) | Yes — pitch-by-pitch |
| NFL | ESPN unofficial | Partial (drive summaries) |
| NBA | ESPN unofficial | Partial (scoring plays) |

Accept the legal gray area for ESPN (personal/dev use), use the official NHL/MLB APIs, and upgrade to a paid tier (MySportsFeeds ~$9/mo) if you need full play-by-play for NFL/NBA or need to display data commercially.
